sources.title: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999
sources.fact: The purchase-credit and separate-cost rules the workflow relies on: s 75-20 (a supply under the margin scheme is not a creditable acquisition, so it gives rise to no input tax credit) and the Division 11 creditable-acquisition provisions for construction and other separate costs. The skill's reference line records the check against compilation C2026C00081 on 10 September 2026; the text view fetched on 2026-09-20 served that same compilation C2026C00081 and carries the s 75-20 margin-scheme wording.
sources.limitations: The Register's text view serves the whole compilation. Retrieve the operative s 75-20 and Division 11 text for the work's period and confirm the compilation is current before allowing or refusing a credit; this index is not authority for a period it does not name.
